## ZBoard v0.0.3 Release Candidate

Changes since the [November 18 release candidate](https://github.com/zerodenet/zboard/releases/tag/v0.0.3-rc.202611180752).

- **Protocol copy order.** ZBoard creates the target protocol, prepares credentials for all selected groups, and then publishes the target node configuration once. The background task shows the preparation and application stages.
- **Subscription delivery.** New protocol endpoints become available in subscriptions and Connect after the target Zero node confirms it applied the configuration containing that endpoint. Missing, failed, and outdated confirmations leave the endpoint pending.

### Upgrade and downloads

Migration `0095` adds an endpoint delivery revision and records the exact endpoint revisions included in each node deployment. Existing endpoints continue to appear in subscriptions. Back up the database and deployment configuration before upgrading. Pin the exact RC tag for the Docker image or download the Linux amd64 binary or offline image from **Assets**. Verify the archives with `SHA256SUMS`.

## 简体中文

本版汇总 [11 月 18 日候选版](https://github.com/zerodenet/zboard/releases/tag/v0.0.3-rc.202611180752) 以来的变更。

- **协议复制顺序。** 先创建目标协议，再为所有选中的节点组准备凭证，最后统一发布一次目标节点配置。后台任务会分别显示准备阶段和下发阶段。
- **订阅交付。** 目标 Zero 节点确认已应用包含该端点的配置后，新端点才会出现在订阅和 Connect 中。回执缺失、失败或过期时，端点继续等待确认。

### 升级和下载

迁移 `0095` 新增端点交付版本，并记录每次节点下发所包含的端点版本。现有端点仍会出现在订阅中。升级前请备份数据库和部署配置。Docker 请固定到准确的 RC 标签。Linux amd64 二进制包和离线镜像见 **Assets**，请用 `SHA256SUMS` 校验。
